definitions.explanation: A room with Western-style flooring (hardwood, carpet, etc.) and furnishings such as beds and chairs, as opposed to a traditional Japanese-style room with tatami mats. Composed of 洋 (Western/ocean) + 室 (room).

examples.japanese: {洋室|ようしつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧、⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Which would you prefer, a Western-style room or a Japanese-style room?

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{洋室|ようしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{三十|さんじゅう}→三十：00984_sanjuu⟧⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This hotel has thirty Western-style rooms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧{部屋|べや}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{洋室|ようしつ}にして、⟦ベッド→ベッド：04501_beddo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧ことにした。
examples.english: We decided to make the children's room Western-style and put in beds.

notes:
USAGE:
{洋室|ようしつ} is contrasted with ⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧ (Japanese-style room). The distinction is important when booking hotels or ryokan, or when describing rooms in a house.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洋室|ようしつ}⟦タイプ→タイプ：01534_taipu⟧ (Western-style room type)
- {洋室|ようしつ}⟦{仕様|しよう}→仕様：00472_shiyou⟧ (Western-room specifications)
- ツイン{洋室|ようしつ} (twin Western-style room)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧ is the opposite — a Japanese-style room with ⟦{畳|たたみ}→畳：02224_tatami⟧ flooring. Many Japanese homes have both {洋室|ようしつ} and ⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧. ⟦{洋間|ようま}→洋間：16339_youma⟧ is a synonym but less common in hotel contexts.
